title: Requirement to evidence matrix for the effective slice
readingRule: A gate is GREEN only if its own instrument reports zero failures and a zero exit code. Nothing is summarised upward; a red gate stays red in this table.

gates.result: All invariants hold; 36 self-tests, including a sabotage case for the test-endpoint rule.

gates.detail: Measured with the foreign broker on the default port stopped, so no result depends on it. The 25 not executed cases are the visible manual and explicit profile; none reports a PASS.

gates.result: 33 packages, exit code 0, hashed, nothing published.
gates.caveat: ViciOne.ServiceBus.MessagePack carries a High advisory through MessagePack 3.1.6.

gates.detail: Both brokers started, so the artemis branch runs instead of falling back to a fixed port.
Two load dependent cases, both 5 of 5 green in isolation at very stable durations. Neither is the shared budget defect; both are reported rather than papered over.

Unsatisfiable as configured: 108 tests need SQL Server LocalDB and 31 need PostgreSQL, neither is a pinned fixture, and LocalDB does not exist on Linux, so the ubuntu runner cannot satisfy it either. Pinning two database fixtures or removing a required category is a lead decision.

summary.whyNot: Two gates are red. entity-framework cannot be satisfied without a decision on database fixtures, and core carries two load dependent cases whose repair would be a new intervention beyond the reslice.

environmentPinning.timezone: UTC, pinned in tools/ci/run_test_category.py and written into every category record
environmentPinning.why: Two cron cases build a template hour in one offset and reuse it across 31 October 2010, the day of a European DST transition: measured 3 of 5 in CEST against 5 of 5 in UTC. Pinning the zone removes an environment difference between a local run and the runner and weakens no assertion.

notADependencyClearance: The pack gate is green and one of its packages carries a High advisory. That is recorded, not cleared.
